label: PORTFOLIO / LAB
content:
// VPN / gateway and NSG counters. Empty until diagnostics are flowing.
union isfuzzy=true
    (
        AzureDiagnostics
        | where TimeGenerated > ago(6h)
        | where ResourceType in ("VIRTUALNETWORKGATEWAYS", "CONNECTIONS")
        | summarize Count = count() by ResourceType, ResultType = tostring(resultType_s), bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
    ),
    (
        AzureMetrics
        | where TimeGenerated > ago(6h)
        | where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.NETWORK"
        | where MetricName in ("TunnelIngressBytes", "TunnelEgressBytes", "BGPPeerStatus")
        | summarize AvgValue = avg(Average) by MetricName, Resource, bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
    ),
    (
        AzureDiagnostics
        | where TimeGenerated > ago(6h)
        | where Category in ("NetworkSecurityGroupEvent", "NetworkSecurityGroupRuleCounter")
        | summarize Count = count() by Category, Rule = tostring(ruleName_s), bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
    )
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 100
